title: ManyDaughters replication materials
description:
Replication materials for Albrecht et al. (2026), The Effect of Data Access on Pre-Analysis Plans: Evidence from a Many-Analyst Study on the Daughters Hypothesis.

The package contains data-preprocessing and analysis code, redistributable project data and derived results, research-team pre-analysis plans and supplementary comments, project communications, and an archived snapshot of the project website.

Licensed German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP) microdata are not included and must be obtained separately from DIW Berlin.
